title: Zero-Length Tape Overlay
statement: Let $x$ and $w$ be Boolean words, let $d$ be a one-work-tape configuration on input $x$, and choose a phase $s$ and input-head position $ip$. The configuration obtained by overlaying a word of length zero on the work tape, with no work-head displacement, is exactly $d$ with only its state set to $s$ and its input-head position set to $ip$.
